purpose: Test fixture for the e2e-engineer. Accounts, passwords and data are fake.

roles.admin: approves any order in its tenant, including over 1000
roles.manager: approves orders up to 1000 in its tenant, not its own
roles.outsider: manager in tenant t2; must not see tenant t1 orders

defects.title: Export button has no click handler
Order creation accepts a negative or non-numeric total
Approval permission is enforced only by hiding the button
defects.detector: rbac-analyst (hidden, not denied) and api-runner (direct call succeeds)

defects.title: A manager reads and approves an order in another tenant
Orders over 1000 can be approved by a manager, so the director step is missing
defects.detector: api-runner (TC-APR-02) and e2e-runner through the UI (TC-E2E-01)

defects.title: Two concurrent approvals of one order both succeed
defects.expected: invariant violated: one approval per order

defects.title: Order detail returns total as a string; the contract says number
A failed approval is shown as a success
The order table is clipped below 600 pixels
defects.detector: web-runner and mobile-runner (mobile web) at each viewport

defects.title: The total input has a placeholder but no label
A test shares mutable order data with another test, so it is flaky
defects.implementedIn: fixtures/planted-app/flaky-cases.json, loaded on top of the plan by the self-test

defects.title: The approve button is shorter than 24 pixels below 600 pixels wide
Android manifest is debuggable with cleartext allowed, and a key is hardcoded

cleanControl: fixtures/planted-app with PLANTED=none, and fixtures/clean-android-config. Both must produce zero defects.
detectedByNote: detectedBy lists the test cases that fail when the defect is switched on alone; the self-test checks this. Defect 11 is detected when TC-FLAKY-02 is classified flaky.
